title: Fuquay-Varina Is Growing, and There’s More to Love

# Fuquay-Varina Is Growing, and There’s More to Love


Tri Pointe Homes


•


October 29, 2026


Share this article


Who says you have to head into the big city to find something good? In Fuquay-Varina, a growing collection of local restaurants, shopping destinations and everyday conveniences are making it easier to enjoy more, right in your own backyard. From discovering a new favorite dinner spot to checking off the shopping list, this Wake County town offers plenty of reasons to stay local, and there’s more on the way.


Fuquay-Varina’s growing popularity is no secret. In 2024, ZIP code 27526 ranked number 20 among more than 41,000 ZIP codes nationwide for the country’s most popular ZIP codes according to an[Opendoor study reported by The News & Observer](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/business/real-estate-news/article298453658.html) . The town’s population also grew nearly 27% between 2020 and 2023, according to Census data cited in that same report.


For residents of[Altis at Serenity by Tri Pointe Homes®](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/altis-at-serenity) , that means enjoying a connected community setting while keeping the places they love to visit within easy reach. With Fuquay-Varina continuing to grow, there’s always something new to explore.


**Close to Home, Close to Everything**


Life at Altis™ at Serenity is designed to make slowing down feel easy. This 55 and better active adult community gives its residents access to amenities designed around staying active, including pickleball courts, a pool, fitness center, yoga studio and dog park. But when it’s time to venture beyond the neighborhood, there’s no shortage of places to go.


Fuquay-Varina’s collection of locally loved spots means residents don’t have to travel far to find their next favorite coffee shop, brewery, restaurant or activity. From the[historic downtown](https://www.fuquay-varina.org/1755/Downtown) area to[growing retail centers](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/business/article317279389.html) , the community is surrounded by the conveniences of everyday life and plenty of opportunities to make the most of it. When residents are looking to venture a little farther, nearby communities like[Holly Springs](https://www.hollyspringsnc.gov/) ,[Lillington](https://www.lillingtonnc.org/) ,[Cary](https://www.carync.gov/) ,[Durham](https://www.durhamnc.gov/) and[Raleigh](https://raleighnc.gov/) offer even more opportunities for recreation, entertainment and outdoor adventures.


**A Growing Shopping Scene with Plenty in Store**


Fuquay-Varina’s retail scene is growing right alongside the town, bringing new options for shopping, dining and errands. Two developments,[Gold Leaf Crossing](https://www.fuquay-varina.org/1397/Gold-Leaf-Crossing) and[Academy Village](https://mpvre.com/properties/academy-village/) , are helping add even more variety to the local mix.


Gold Leaf Crossing, a major new retail development, is expanding\[AAP1\] shopping, dining and everyday convenience to the area. The development includes a new[Target](https://www.target.com/sl/fuquay-varina/2936) along with a growing lineup of future tenants. Those include[Firebirds Wood Fired Grill](https://firebirdsrestaurants.com/) ,[Paris Baguette](https://parisbaguette.com/) ,[Nothing Bundt Cakes](https://www.nothingbundtcakes.com/) ,[Mezeh Mediterranean Grill](https://mezeh.com/) ,[Alpaca Chicken](https://www.alpacachicken.com/) and[Super Chix](https://www.superchix.com/menu) . Once open, these businesses will give residents more choices for grabbing a quick bite or treat.


Meanwhile,[Academy Village](https://mpvre.com/properties/academy-village/) is also flourishing, with new businesses joining the shopping center and adding options for dining, fitness, personal care and everyday services. A few confirmed retailers that are coming to Academy village are[Lowe’s Foods](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/business/article307263616.html) ,[Club Pilates](https://www.clubpilates.com/) and[Potbelly Sandwich Shop](https://www.potbelly.com/) .


Developments like these are helping make Fuquay-Varina an increasingly convenient place to call home, with broader selections for everyday essentials and outings alike.


**Adventures Close to Home**


From morning coffee runs and visits to the farmers market to evening dinner and drinks, Fuquay-Varina offers its residents a full day of local fun!


Just five miles from Altis at Serenity, residents can start their morning off with a coffee from[Cultivate Coffee Roasters](https://www.cultivate.coffee/) , then spend the afternoon exploring local shops, from gifts at[Southernly Place](https://southernlyplace.com/) and antiques at[KnB’s Marketplace](https://knbmarketplace.wordpress.com/about/) to fresh finds at the local farmer’s market,[Fuquay-Varina Growers Market](https://www.fvgrowersmarket.com/) . Another close by farmer’s market is the[Holly Springs Farmer’s Market](https://www.hollyspringsnc.gov/319/Farmers-Market) , giving residents the chance to shop local and pick up fresh finds.


Local favorites can be found at[Quaint Plaza](http://quaintplaza.com/) , a multi-level space where food, fitness and entertainment come together under one roof. Among other businesses, Quaint Plaza houses popular food stops like[Fat Cat Homemade Ice Cream](https://fatcathomemadeicecream.com/) and[Momo Station](https://momostationnc.com/) and entertainment picks like[Virtu-Alley,](https://virtu-alley.com/) a gaming lounge that features virtual reality simulators. When happy hour rolls around, Fuquay-Varina has no shortage of options, including[Aviator Brewing Company](https://aviatorbrew.com/) or[The Mason Jar Lager Company](https://www.masonjarlagerco.com/) each just four miles from Altis at Serenity.


Fuquay-Varina’s restaurant scene brings plenty of flavor to the table when searching for a dinner spot. With Mediterranean dishes at[Nil’s Mediterranean Cuisine](https://fuquay.nilsmc.com/) to authentic Indian dishes at[Zeera Indian Restaurant](https://www.zeeranc.com/) , Thai flavors at[Khao Sen](https://khaosen.com/) and classic Italian at[Garibaldi Trattoria Pizza and Pasta,](https://garibalditrattoriapizza.com/) folks can easily turn a night out into a culinary adventure without even needing to leave the town limits. For a taste of local history,[Joyce & Family Restaurant](https://www.joyceandfamilyrestaurant.com/) has been serving cozy Southern comfort and soul food in Fuquay-Varina since 1997.


**A Growing Town That Still Feels Like Home**


One of the perks of living in a growing town is watching new ventures take shape close to home. With established local businesses, expanding shopping centers and more restaurants coming, Fuquay-Varina continues to offer residents new ways to shop, dine and spend their time.


And while there’s plenty to enjoy locally, the town’s location also keeps the greater Triangle within reach for those looking to explore even more.


[Altis at Serenity by Tri Pointe Homes®](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/altis-at-serenity) offers 1- and 2- story single-family 55+ active adult homes ranging from 1,281 to 3,290 square feet, with 2-4 bedrooms and 2-3 bathrooms. From the luxury amenities this community offers to the convenience and character of Fuquay-Varina, it’s a place to relax and enjoy the day without ever having to go far, all in one little slice of the Triangle!
